Faculty Profiles
Intelligent Systems and Robotics Department faculty contact and bio information.
Dr. Kristen "Brent" Venable
Position: Director of the Intelligent Systems and Robotics doctoral program
Department: Intelligent Systems and Robotics
Office Location: Building 4, Room 139
Brent Venable is the inaugural director for UWF’s intelligent systems and robotics doctoral program.
bvenable@uwf.edu
850.474.2523
Full Bio
Dr. Nikhil Vishwas Divekar
Position: Assistant Professor
Department: Intelligent Systems and Robotics
Office Location: Building 4, Room 243
Dr. Nikhil Divekar is an Assistant Professor in Intelligent Systems and Robotics. His research interests lie at the intersection of neurophysiology, biomechanics, and robotics, focusing on mechanical design and ML-enhanced control of wearable and assistive robots such as exoskeletons and prostheses.
ndivekar@uwf.edu
850.474.2963
Full Bio
Dr. Brian Jalaian
Position: Associate Professor
Department: Computer Science; Intelligent Systems and Robotics
Office Location: Campus: Building 4, Room 434;
Dr. Brian Jalaian, an Associate Professor (ISR) and a research scientist (IHMC), is interested in the research of robust machine learning, uncertainty quantification for machine learning, deep learning, AI safety and security, AI assurance, optimization and network science.
bjalaian@uwf.edu
850.474.2963
Full Bio
Dr. Stephen Russell
Position: Professor
Department: Intelligent Systems and Robotics
Office Location: Remote Office
Dr. Stephen Russell is a Professor in the Intelligent Systems and Robotics Department. His research interests include AI and data Science in healthcare, intelligent agents for AI/machine learning, knowledge discovery, and information-driven tasks, and intelligent systems adopt human-machine teaming.
russell@uwf.edu
850.474.2517
Full Bio
Dr. Hakki Erhan Sevil
Position: Associate Professor
Department: Intelligent Systems and Robotics
Office Location: Campus: Building 4, Room 328;
Downtown: 220 W Garden St, Suite 250, Office 224
Dr. Hakki Erhan Sevil, an Associate Professor in the Intelligent Systems and Robotics Program, is interested in researching robotics, guidance and path planning, fault detection and isolation, autonomous navigation, and obstacle avoidance.
hsevil@uwf.edu
850.474.3236
